title: March Madness Reportedly Generates $410M of In-Game Brand Exposure

facts.fact: Men's and women's March Madness delivered more than $410 million worth of media exposure value for featured brands in telecasts, according to a report by Elevate Sports Ventures and Hive.
facts.quote: Men’s and women’s March Madness delivered **more than $410 million worth of media exposure value** for featured brands in telecasts, [according](https://elevatesportsventures.com/news/marchmadness2) to a report by Elevate Sports Ventures and Hive.

facts.fact: Per Elevate Sports Ventures and Hive, March Madness media exposure value of more than $410 million was more than double the estimated $170 million generated by Super Bowl LVI.
facts.quote: That’s more than double the [delivery](https://frontofficesports.com/super-bowl-generated-170m-in-game-brand-exposure/) for **Super Bowl LVI**, which generated an estimated $170 million.

facts.fact: Capital One, Coca-Cola, AT&T, Nike, and Spalding together earned 56% of all media value from March Madness, per the Elevate Sports Ventures and Hive report.
facts.quote: Together, **Capital One**, **Coca-Cola**, **AT&T**, **Nike**, and **Spalding**earned 56% of all media value.

facts.fact: Capital One led the women's March Madness tournament with 13 hours and 25 minutes of brand exposure.
facts.quote: Capital One led the women’s tournament with 13 hours and 25 minutes of exposure, while AT&T led the men’s with nine hours and 13 minutes.

facts.fact: Companies received about 187 total hours of exposure during all 134 men's and women's March Madness games.
facts.quote: In all, companies received about 187 total hours of exposure during all 134 men’s and women’s games.

facts.fact: The women's March Madness championship game peaked at almost 6 million viewers.
facts.quote: with the championship game peaking at almost **6 million viewers**. It averaged 18% more than 2021, and 30% more than 2019.

facts.fact: Women's March Madness viewership averaged 18% more than in 2021 and 30% more than in 2019.
facts.quote: It averaged 18% more than 2021, and 30% more than 2019.

facts.fact: From the last day of the women's second round onward, both tournaments generated $245 million in exposure, while up to that point $165 million had been generated, per Elevate and Hive.
facts.quote: From the last day of the women’s second round onward, both tournaments generated **$245 million** in exposure. Elevate and Hive found that up to that point, $165 million had been generated.

facts.fact: Spalding earned the most exposure time of any brand during early rounds, helped by the basket stanchion arm.
facts.quote: An early-round winner for product placement was the basket stanchion arm, which helped Spalding earn the most exposure time of any brand during early rounds.

facts.fact: The 12-team College Football Playoff was implemented in 2024.
The College Football Playoff officially announced plans to expand in 2027.
facts.quote: The CFP officially announced plans to expand in 2027.

facts.fact: The highest-ranked Group of 6 conference champion will earn an automatic College Football Playoff berth each year.
facts.quote: The highest-ranked G6 conference champion will earn an automatic CFP berth each year.

facts.fact: Minnesota sent Las Vegas a third-round pick in exchange for Kirk Cousins.
facts.quote: Minnesota sent Las Vegas a third-round pick for Cousins.

facts.fact: BetUS announced 'The Russini Report,' a show hosted by Dianna Russini, on a Monday in November 2026.
facts.quote: BetUS announced ‘The Russini Report’ on Monday.

facts.fact: The Sunday Night Football game Mike Tirico was out for was set to be his 300th NFL broadcast.
facts.quote: The game was set to be Tirico’s 300th NFL broadcast.

facts.fact: ESPN sent guidelines warning on-camera talent about insider betting on prediction markets at the end of October.
facts.quote: The guidelines were sent to on-camera talent at the end of October.

facts.fact: ABC and ESPN were set to broadcast five top-25 college football matchups on a Saturday.
facts.quote: The networks will broadcast five top-25 matchups Saturday.

facts.fact: Dianna Russini's new media content is expected to be sponsored by gambling operators.
facts.quote: Russini’s new content is expected to be sponsored by gambling operators.
